answer: Proof-of-unique-latency: a registry sends each new agent timed compute puzzles that must be solved on its own hardware, seeded from a hash unique to it. Running 1,000 fake identities then needs 1,000 times the compute and memory in parallel, so cost scales linearly. A velvet-smooth ramp-up and a terrace of rising difficulty tiers let honest agents reach the zenith of reputation cheaply, while farms stall.
